_about: Swap ideas for tax-loss harvesting: buy one of these after selling at a loss, so you stay invested while the loss counts.
funds: groups of ETFs with (nearly) the same exposure. A member is matched by its ISIN, ticker or 'also' tickers.
UK residents get UCITS members (market UK): first a fund on the same index from another provider, then a different index.
US residents get US-listed members (market US) on a different index only, since two funds on one index may be 'substantially identical'.
stocks: single shares matched by ISIN or ticker, with a close peer and a sector ETF (key into sector_etfs, else their 'sector').
sector_etfs: keyed by Yahoo sector name (what sectors.get_sectors() returns); also the fallback for shares not listed here.
Every ticker resolves on Yahoo Finance (checked 2026-11-14). Not advice: a swap tracks differently from what you sold.
